name: PNGdec
description: bitbank2 PNGdec, vendored from x4-os .pio/libdeps (registry pin 1.1.6). Trimmed to the decoder core + its embedded zlib inflate: no examples, no PNGDisplay wrapper, no infback.c, no S3 SIMD .S file. PNG_MAX_BUFFERED_PIXELS is raised via platformio.ini build_flags (same value as x4-os) so wide cover images fit the two internal scanline buffers.
